name: Cayanan, Airoen Boevey G.
course: Information Technology at Angeles University Foundation
story: I started Pawly after seeing how many loving dogs were waiting in shelters, overlooked and in need of care. What began as a small act of kindness grew into a mission to help dogs heal, feel safe, and find forever homes where they are truly valued.

Every rescue has a story. Some arrive frightened and unsure, while others need medical attention, patience, and time to trust again. I believe that every dog deserves a future shaped by dignity, comfort, and unconditional love.

values.title: Compassion first
values.text: We believe every dog deserves a safe place, thoughtful care, and a future built on trust.

values.title: Care with purpose
values.text: From rescue to recovery, we focus on the health, comfort, and emotional well-being of every dog.

values.title: Families for life
values.text: We match each dog with the right home through gentle guidance, support, and long-term care.
